Class Turn

java.lang.Object
pokemonjavaedition.Turn
public class Turn extends Object
It manages all the calculation and checks that has to be done during a battle turn or before starting it, like the damage done, which pokemon is the faster ecc...

      public static Player speedCheck()
      It check which pokemon is faster, returning then the "faster" player between the two. If the move choosen is switch, the player has a priority, 'cause in pokemon if a player change a pokemon, it acts as the first in every case.

    • attack

      public static void attack(Player p)
      It calculates the total damage that a player's pokemon does against the enemy. It also check if a move is supereffective using the checkType() method and if a stat needs to be boosted or nerfed using the checkStage() method.
      Parameters:
      p - the player who will use his current pokemon to attack the other player.
